summary.text: Anita Bonds is an At-Large member of the Council of the District of Columbia; the Council lists her time on the Council as 2012 to present.

paragraphs.text: She previously served as Chair of the DC Democratic State Committee and as a cabinet member in the administrations of Mayors Anthony Williams, Sharon Pratt and Marion Barry.
She attended the University of California, Berkeley, and is a mother of three.
